fieldValues.title: 9. Learn and remember: what we tried and where we went too far
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
The ideal: What happened is reported, measured and ratified, and the practice and its one statement change because of it, so the next session starts from it.

What we have tried: Run reports and session reports; srs-context and the dream cycle; the handbook as records with a watcher; indicators (I1 grounding); retrospectives, the archaeology and the work-flow audit; CLAUDE.md pointers in every repository.

Problems recorded here: SP-65, SP-67, SP-68, SP-43, SP-69, SP-53, SP-104.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Line 1, Record what happened and change the practice: too far toward Record. Stated principles have no enforcement point (SP-43); a ratified rule and the practice running today say opposite things (SP-104).
- Line 2, Restate where needed and one home: too far toward both restate where needed and one home, by turns. The same rule restated drifts (SP-65) and the handbook said things no longer true (SP-67); on 2026-10-25 the issue flow was missed because the pointer was one line and the home 1,900 lines.
- Line 3, Each agent's memory and shared memory: too far toward Each agent's memory. No one place tells how work is driven (SP-68); process facts kept in agent memories went stale within a day (srs-context convention 3ad2bf3a).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions:
- The three tensions are a first pass: none has its four 2×2 cases or the cube filled yet (handbook, A domain's axes, steps 3 and 4).
- Is each tension orthogonal to the other two in this stage, and which pole is yang here: does it flip from the parent domain?
fieldValues.next_action: Fill the 2×2 cases from the stage's own history; then name the remedy that moves us back out of each shadow.
